paras: At Dun Modr, Ashlan Stonesmirk watches the border with the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. The dwarven explosives expert keeps alert for dangers threatening Ironforge.

At Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, Ashlan Stonesmirk serves the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. His knowledge of explosives makes him a useful contact when suspicious materials threaten dwarven defenses.
